checks.claim: EA ground-truth points are independently surveyed on flat unambiguous surfaces.
Each EA ground-truth point is stated as +/-3 cm RMSE.
Ground-truth records include transformation and geoidal models used.
Ground truth may support multiple LIDAR surveys when less than 5 years old.
For coastal projects the ground-truth age limit is 3 years.
LIDAR survey QC requires error below +/-15 cm RMSE.
LIDAR survey QC requires standard deviation below 10 cm.
LIDAR survey QC requires random error below 10 cm.
Ground-truth dataset coordinate reference system is EPSG:27700.
